data.claim: Conflict between the category-error framing (protocol-level distinguishability is the real invariant, not an operation property of writers) and the layer-boundary framing (safety of writers, idempotency of readers): calling the idempotency/safety distinction a category error means neither 'safety of writers' nor 'idempotency of readers' is the correct characterization, while the layer-boundary view holds these are genuine, faithfully describable layer-bound obligations.
data.qualification: ART_19, ART_22, ART_23, and ART_24 describe this contradiction and its potential refutation conditions.
